smooth_signal_savitzky_golay: smooth noisy 1D signal data using a Savitzky-Golay low-pass filter with a configurable window size and polynomial order
differentiate_signal_savitzky_golay: compute the first or higher-order derivative of a signal using the Savitzky-Golay filter with deriv parameter
build_smoothing_module: build a python module that applies Savitzky-Golay smoothing to remove high-frequency noise from sensor or time-series data
test_savitzky_golay_filter: test the savitzky_golay function by smoothing a noisy Gaussian signal and comparing output shape to input
refactor_savitzky_golay_pinv: refactor the savitzky_golay function to replace np.linalg.pinv with a more numerically stable least-squares solver
